question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.

He __**imputes **__his ability to play great football to an inspirational coach.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"attributes"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"attributes"** is the most appropriate synonym of **"imputes"**.
 
• **Imputes: **attributes or ascribe
 
 
• **Example: **People **impute** great cleverness to cats.
